ui.RefillswhilealiveDoesnotpreventonehit: Refills while alive. Does not prevent one-hit or scripted deaths.
ui.Usesthelocalplayersstaminaconsumption: Uses the local player's stamina-consumption flag. Turning it off restores its previous setting.
ui.Healthandstaminacontrolsstopwhenplaye: Health and stamina controls stop when player validation fails.
ui.0999999999ChangesthecurrentbalanceThe: 0–999,999,999 · Changes the current balance. The game may save this value.
ui.199perattributeBloodLevelfollowstheat: 1–99 per attribute. Blood Level follows the attribute change. Apply while idle, then quit to title and reload your character to refresh derived stats.
ui.Nativeinvincibilityavoidnormalattackh: Native invincibility: avoid normal attack hits and reactions. Scripted events and grabs need live testing.
ui.UsesthenativedeathpenaltyskipflagDoes: Uses the native death-penalty skip flag. Does not refill Echoes or prevent spending. Live death/bloodstain testing pending.
ui.01100Setbothto1andApplytorestoreinclu: 0.1–100×. Set both to 1 and Apply to restore, including leftover BB Tools effects. Selections resume after loading; effects expire shortly after the tool stops updating.
ui.Selectionsstayonthroughloadingscreens: Selections stay on through loading screens and warps. They resume when the player validates. Disconnecting clears selections; turning them off restores the settings they replaced.
ui.Enablesprotectioninfinitebulletsstami: Enables protection, infinite bullets/stamina and 0.1× outgoing damage. Turns off one-shot, enemy AI disabling, invisibility and silence so enemies can attack. Leaves Echoes rewards unchanged. Equip a firearm and carry bullets first.
ui.Lockontoalivingenemybeforeenablingtar: Lock onto a living enemy before enabling target protection or restoring its health.
ui.Targetprotectionallowsnormaldamageand: Target protection allows normal damage and reactions, preventing ordinary lethal HP damage. Scripted deaths and phase transitions can still occur. Loading/death or an invalid target stops protection; re-enable it deliberately. These target actions are never saved in startup presets.
ui.Clearsthefivebuildupgaugeswhilethepla: Clears the five buildup gauges while the player validates. Cure poison removes only active slow/rapid poison effects through the native engine. Clear buildup resets meters; neither reverses damage already taken or guarantees one-hit immunity.
ui.Keepequippedweaponsatfulldurability.d: Keep equipped weapons at full durability
ui.Repairusesthenativeequippedweaponrout: Repair uses the native equipped-weapon routine. Results for each slot appear here.
ui.Refillsequippedweapondurabilitywhilet: Refills equipped weapon durability while the character validates. Full-durability mode takes priority over the threshold. Disabling resumes normal wear; repairs can be saved by the game.
ui.Searchpresetsbynameorgroup.9b37105: Search presets by name or group
ui.StoresFOVapppreferencescombattogglesh: Stores FOV, app preferences, combat toggles, health refill, stamina and applied multipliers locally. Apply explicitly after connecting. Matching names replace saved presets; character stats and Echoes balances are excluded.
ui.SelectthebossinTravelthenstartmanuall: Select the boss in Travel, then start manually. Time pauses while the player is unavailable or dead. Finish manually to record a personal best; stats are for this app session.
ui.Lockontoanenemyinthegametobegin.6ac1a: Lock onto an enemy in the game to begin.
ui.Updatesevery200msUnlockingkeepsthesam: Updates every 200 ms. Unlocking keeps the same enemy and continues reading it while valid. Loading, death/unloading or disconnect retains the last known data until another enemy is targeted.
ui.Azerolimitdoesnotbyitselfproveimmunit: A zero limit does not by itself prove immunity. Super armor is the native stagger system, not Elden Ring's stance meter or a boss's separate limb-health pool. Break count is sampled and can miss very brief transitions.
ui.Allcapturednativeeffectsarelistedincl: All captured native effects are listed, including buffs and pending entries. Unknown effects retain their ID and native state number; no guessed names. Untimed entries do not expose a countdown.
ui.ChooseacommonitemorenterabaseitemIDan: Choose a common item, or enter a base item ID and category.
ui.DecimalmodebaseIDselectedcategoryWiki: Decimal mode: base ID + selected category. Wiki mode: paste the full hexadecimal Item ID, e.g. 400003E8. A 0x prefix also selects hexadecimal mode.
ui.Importallitemnamesfromgamefiles.92dca: Import all item names from game files
ui.SearchcommonitemnamesorIDs.b4a31df: Search common item names or IDs
ui.Goods199Equipment1CustomIDsmustexisti: Goods: 1–99. Equipment: 1. Custom IDs must exist in your game. The game handles inventory limits and storage; check your inventory after the request completes.
ui.Levelupfortifyrepairstoragebloodgemsa: Level up, fortify, repair, storage, blood gems and Caryll runes. Close other menus first and use while idle. Costs apply unless the matching free option above is enabled. Close normally in the game.
ui.FilterlampsbynameorDLC.dcfb2c7: Filter lamps by name or DLC
ui.All45namedbasegameandDLCdestinationsB: All 45 named base-game and DLC destinations. Boss-arena lamps do not reset bosses or unlock quest flags. Use the chalice altar controls below for generated dungeons. Warp while idle.
ui.StartfromHuntersDreamChooseanexisting: Start from Hunter's Dream. Choose an existing altar and one of its unlocked layer lamps. Uses that character's generated dungeon and progress. Empty rituals and locked lamps are rejected; this does not create dungeons or unlock lamps.
ui.Replaystheoriginalencountertriggerand: Replays the original encounter trigger and intro. Fog follows first-visit rules; enter the arena to begin. Leave off for a repeat fight. AI/invisibility overrides can keep bosses passive.
ui.Oneclickresetssavedencounterflagsandr: One click resets saved encounter flags and reloads the selected boss area. Can be used from any area, including mid-fight; this can disrupt the encounter or story progress. Supports all 22 boss destinations including DLC. New Micolash and ending-boss profiles are experimental. Moon Presence enables its encounter route; defeating ending bosses may advance NG/story state. Original flags are journaled locally. Use a separate practice save.
ui.22bossentrancesincludingallfiveDLCbos: 22 boss entrances, including all five DLC bosses. Travel to the area, wait for loading, then go to the entrance. Travel/entrance buttons relocate you; revival controls reset supported encounters separately. Doors and story prerequisites are unchanged.
ui.StopspendingplacementTravelalreadyreq: Stops pending placement. Travel already requested and revival flag changes are retained.
ui.Storesnamedpositionsinthelocallibrary: Stores named positions in the local library between app sessions. Search by name or map. Restore within the same loaded map; travel to its lamp first when elsewhere. Chalice bookmarks are bound to this connection, character, altar, dungeon and progress snapshot; reconnecting or changing that state requires a fresh bookmark.
ui.FOVandcameraoverridesareexperimentala: ⚠ FOV and camera overrides are experimental and unstable. They can reduce performance and cause visual issues. Restore defaults if problems occur.
ui.Connecttoaloadedcharacter38120vertica: Connect to a loaded character. 38–120° vertical. Wide angles automatically remove the camera clamp in memory; no external patch is required. Disabling restores the clamp if this app changed it.
ui.Usescameraparameterrowsandpreservesth: Uses camera parameter rows and preserves their individual original values. Changes ease in through the game camera and resume after loads. Disable or disconnect to restore. Camera angles are vertical, not horizontal.
ui.Scaleseachcamerarowsoriginaldistancea: Scales each camera row's original distance and look-at height. Disable to restore; included in saved and startup presets.
ui.HidingfrontendUImayhidegamemenustooUn: Hiding front-end UI may hide game menus too. Uncheck here to restore; disconnect also restores the captured value.
ui.Overrideworldgravityallactorsandobjec: Override world gravity (all actors and objects)
ui.Movementscalesplayertranslationwithou: Movement scales player translation without speeding up enemies. Gravity affects the entire physics world. Use a practice save; extreme values can break collision and scripted movement. Disable or disconnect to restore owned changes.
ui.Returntoflightstartanddisable.9badbff: Return to flight start and disable
ui.WiththegamefocusedholdCtrltheconfigur: With the game focused, hold Ctrl + the configured camera movement keys (WASD, E/Q by default). Uses repeated native coordinate relocation. Enable deliberately each session; not applied by startup presets. Disabling in midair can drop the player. Cross-map travel stops flight. Use a practice save.
ui.Startphotomodefocusthegametomovetheca: Start photo mode, focus the game to move the camera, then capture. The world keeps running.
ui.FiltersapplytosavedphotosCaptureanima: Filters apply to saved photos. Capture an image to preview adjustments and save a separate edited copy. The original PNG stays unchanged.
ui.LosslessPNGatthedisplayedgameresoluti: Lossless PNG at the displayed game resolution. Rebind controls in Settings. Exit restores camera, hunter movement and HUD; loading/death ends photo mode.

ui.Findthebestgameprocessandconnectautom: Find the best game process and connect automatically
ui.Checkseverythreesecondswhiledisconnec: Checks every three seconds while disconnected. Prefers a loaded character after verifying the game image. Reconnects when the engine restarts. Manual disconnect pauses automatic connection until you reconnect or toggle this setting.
ui.BasicpresenceshowsBloodborneandtherun: Basic presence shows Bloodborne and the runtime with the Discord application’s Bloodborne logo and a GitHub button. Clears when disconnected or disabled. Discord desktop must be running.

ui.SavecurrentFOVasstartupdefault.67a915: Save current FOV as startup default
ui.Startuppresetsapplyonceperconnectionw: Startup presets apply once per connection when a living character is ready. Choose the preset in Combat. Stats, Echoes balances, spawning, warps and boss revival never run automatically.
ui.ShortcutmodifierchooseNoneforFkeysalo: Shortcut modifier (choose None for F-keys alone)
ui.ActiveonlywhiletheconnectedgameorBBTo: Active only while the connected game or BB Tools has focus; ignored while typing in the app. Save/restore uses a Quick bookmark. Retry resets and reloads the selected boss from any area. Press the modifier shown above plus the chosen F-key. These keys also reach the game; avoid conflicting game bindings. Duplicate shortcuts are rejected.
ui.Exportspresetslocationsanditemfavorit: Exports presets, locations and item favorites. Import validates everything before committing; matching names are replaced. Importing never applies presets, spawns items or warps. Database backup is a consistent SQLite snapshot.

loot.heading: ITEM DISCOVERY & ENEMY DROPS
loot.enable: Boost item discovery without changing Arcane
loot.description: Adds 0–1000 discovery points on top of the native Arcane/rune calculation, including in chalice dungeons. Does not edit Arcane, Blood Level or other attributes. Does not force higher-quality blood gems.
loot.guaranteeHelp: Includes eligible chalice-dungeon enemy rolls. Removes blank outcomes when at least one valid weighted item is eligible. Keeps relative rarity and quantities; does not drop every item, change gem quality/effects, create missing loot, bypass progression or change chest/scripted rewards.
loot.testing: Experimental · live testing pending. Disable or disconnect to restore. May conflict with runtime mods that replace loot/discovery code.
loot.paused: Discovery/drops paused: {0} Toggle the option to retry.
language.community: COMMUNITY TRANSLATIONS · Help fill missing text and review terminology.
connection.accessDenied: Windows denied access to the game process. Close BB Tools, right-click BBTools.exe and choose Run as administrator, then reconnect. This may be needed when the game or launcher is elevated.
insight.heading: INSIGHT
insight.hint: 0–99. Changes the current balance; the game may save it.
progression.heading: PROGRESSION COSTS
progression.hint: Enable before opening Level up or Fortify weapons. Costs no Blood Echoes or upgrade materials. Reopen the menu after changing these settings. Normal level and upgrade limits still apply. Costs restore when disabled or disconnected.
progression.paused: Progression costs paused: {0} Toggle the setting to retry.
camera.horizontalHint: Left −2 · Centre 0 · Right +2. Applies to normal gameplay camera; extreme offsets can clip through scenery.
camera.enableTuning: Override camera distance, height and shoulder offset
gems.heading: BLOOD-GEM EDITOR
gems.help: Create a custom blood gem or load a carried gem as a template. Creating an edited copy keeps the original. Refresh with a character loaded; names can be imported from your own game files.
gems.import: Import effect names from game files
gems.effects: EFFECTS — SEARCH BY NAME OR ID
gems.emptyHint: Slots 1–6, left to right. Use -1 for empty. IDs are GemeffectParam entries, not ordinary item IDs. Choose at least one effect. Changes persist in the game save.
gems.pending: Pending in-game testing. Start with one gem and check it in the workshop.
gems.connect: Connect to a loaded character and wait for any pending action to finish.
gems.loaded: Loaded {0:N0} effects and {1:N0} carried blood gems.
gems.copyLoaded: Gem loaded. Creating an edited copy leaves the original unchanged.
gems.created: Configured blood gem confirmed in carried inventory. Equip it through the workshop.
gems.integer: Effect IDs must be whole numbers; use -1 for an empty slot.
support.heading: SUPPORT BB TOOLS
support.description: BB Tools is built and maintained by James Cicada, a solo developer. If you enjoy the tool, consider supporting its development on Ko-fi. Every contribution helps — thank you!
ng.heading: NG CYCLE
ng.hint: 0 = NG, 1 = NG+. Range 0–999; difficulty scaling caps at NG+6. Load the current value before applying. Reload the area or quit to title and continue to refresh existing enemies. Changes may be saved; this does not reset quests or begin a new journey.
ng.loaded: Current NG cycle loaded. Edit the number and apply when ready.
ng.reloadFirst: Load the current NG cycle before applying.
ng.applied: NG cycle updated. Reload the area or quit to title and continue to refresh existing enemies.
experimental.enable: Enable experimental camera and noclip tools
experimental.help: Off by default. Reveals Photo studio and Camera → Movement flight/noclip controls. Enabling this setting does not start a mode. No external patches are required. Camera bindings can be changed below.
experimental.warning: Experimental — not tested in-game. Camera, controls or collision may misbehave. Disable this setting to stop active modes and restore their owned state.
experimental.saved: Experimental preference saved. Camera and noclip modes remain manual.
experimental.exitBeforeAction: Exit photo mode or flight before submitting a game action.
experimental.waitForAction: Wait for the current game action or camera preparation to finish.
experimental.cleanupPending: Previous camera or flight restoration is still pending. Wait until the character has loaded, then retry.
